title: server.rs: session handler unwraps serde_json::to_value
description:
Why this issue exists: In crates/mail/src/server.rs the JMAP session endpoint calls serde_json::to_value(session).unwrap(). SessionResource contains only serializable fields today, but a future change adding a non-string map key or a type that fails serialization would crash the server process.

What needs to be done: Replace .unwrap() with proper error propagation returning a 500 Internal Server Error HTTP response.
